一步步完成 DecisionForge 任务。: complete DecisionForge tasks step by step.
数据准备、模型训练、评测与分析，通过五个项目 skills 协作完成。你决定目标: Prepare data, train models, evaluate and analyze with five project skills. You choose goals and resources; the Agent proposes a plan, executes commands and preserves traceable results.
在设置 → 模型中配置可用服务，并在聊天框中选择模型。Agent 聊天凭据与生成: Configure a provider in Settings → Models and select a model in chat. Agent chat credentials are separate from generation, Checker, retrieval, MinerU and evaluation credentials.
通过项目的 npm start 启动时，会自动添加并选择当前 checkout。: The project npm start launcher adds and selects the current checkout. With standalone dsh web, add and select the complete DecisionForge repository manually. You can switch workspaces later.
Launch from a terminal with the required Python environment. First check pwd, sys.executable and README so commands use the correct directory and interpreter.
每一步都有明确的方案与结果: A clear plan and result at every stage
以下是端到端路线。只需要某个阶段时，直接调用对应 skill；已有合格数据或报告: This is the complete route. Invoke a stage skill directly when you only need that stage; reuse qualified data and reports.
总体路线确认只确定范围和顺序。每个具体业务阶段先展示策略、配置、资源与产物，得到: Route approval sets scope and order. Before each business stage, review strategy, configuration, resources and outputs. Silence is not approval; existing valid authorization continues to apply.
有自有数据：先固定独立评测集，再准备训练数据。只有场景：先寻找资料、整理数据，再: With existing data, reserve an independent evaluation set before preparing training data. With only a scenario, find sources and prepare data before choosing training or an existing model. Separate training, validation and final test sources.
从 /dforge 开始，或直接选一个阶段: Start with /dforge or choose a stage
在聊天中输入 /名称 加任务描述。先提供已有的文件路径、配置、模型和资源；缺少的: Enter /name followed by your task. Provide existing paths, configuration, models and resources; work through missing decisions with the Agent.
指令来自当前仓库的 .agents/skills/，共享规则与项目文档按需读取。: Instructions live in .agents/skills/ in the current repository. Shared rules and documentation are read as needed. This guide introduces the workflow; project files and implementation define methods and parameters.
结果放在任务目录，下一次从这里继续: Continue from the task directory next time
README.md 是任务入口；task.json 记录阶段、决定、授权与待决定: README.md is the task entry. task.json records stages, decisions, authorization and pending questions. The Agent returns real configuration, log, model and report paths. Chat preserves conversation; task directories preserve execution evidence.
暂停时保存状态；停止生成只中断当前 Agent 轮次，后台作业是否停止需单独核查: Save state when pausing. Stopping a reply only interrupts the current Agent turn; check background jobs separately. On reopening, inspect processes, manifests and outputs to avoid duplicate submissions.
